related_questions.question: What's the difference between an ESTA and a visa?
related_questions.snippet: An approved ESTA is not a visa. It does not meet the legal or regulatory requirements to serve in lieu of a U.S. visa when a visa is required under U.S. law. Individuals who possess a valid visa will still be able to travel to the United States on that visa for the purpose for which it was issued.

text_blocks.snippet: A digital nomad visa is a special type of visa that allows remote workers to live and work in a foreign country for an extended period, typically longer than a standard tourist visa. It's designed for individuals who can work remotely for a company or clients outside of the host country. This visa enables digital nomads to experience living in different countries while maintaining their current employment or freelancing work.
snippet_highlighted_words: a special type of visa that allows remote workers to live and work in a foreign country for an extended period, typically longer than a standard tourist visa

list.title: Purpose:
list.snippet: Digital nomad visas are intended to attract remote workers and their spending power to a country, boosting tourism and local economies.

list.title: Key Feature:
list.snippet: They allow remote workers to legally live and work in a country without needing a traditional work permit or being tied to a specific job in that country.

list.title: Eligibility:
list.snippet: Typically, applicants need to demonstrate that their income is generated from sources outside the host country and that they meet the minimum income requirements set by the country offering the visa.

list.title: Duration:
list.snippet: These visas are usually issued for a specific period, often a year, with the possibility of extensions.

list.title: Benefits:
list.snippet: Digital nomad visas offer flexibility and freedom to travel and live in different locations, while still having the security of a stable income from remote work.

list.title: Popularity:
list.snippet: The concept of digital nomad visas has gained significant traction, with more countries introducing them to cater to the growing remote work trend.

list.title: Examples:
list.snippet: Countries like Estonia, Croatia, and Barbados are known for offering digital nomad visas.
